title: The expanding universe
info: Distant galaxies, beyond our local neighborhood, show light stretched toward the red end of the rainbow. That is cosmological redshift.
Space itself is stretching. Earth is not the unique center. Every distant galaxy sees others moving away.
Andromeda is an exception nearby: it is moving toward the Milky Way.

The Big Bang is the name for the hot, dense early universe, not an explosion into empty space that already existed. A faint glow across the sky is leftover from when the universe first became see-through.

questions.explain: Gravity holds the solar system and the Local Group together. Expansion shows up over much larger distances.
